qasam hai unn ( hawaon ) ki jo gard urra ker bikhair deti hain ,
phir unn ki jo ( badalon ka ) bojh uthati hain ,
phir unn ki jo aasani say rawan dawan hojati hain ,
phir unn ki jo cheezen taqseem kerti hain ,
kay jo wada tum say kiya jaraha hai , woh yaqeeni tor per sacha hai ,
aur aemal ka badla yaqeenan mil ker rahey ga .
qasam hai raaston walay aasman ki ,
kay tum mutazaad baaton mein parray huye ho ,
iss ( aakhirat ki haqeeqat ) say wohi mun morrta hai jo haq say bilkul hi murra huwa hai .
khuda ki maar ho unn per jo ( aqeeday kay moamlay mein ) atkal peechon baaten banaya kertay hain ,
jo ghaflat mein aesay doobay hain kay sabb kuch bhulaye bethay hain .
poochtay hain kay :  jaza o saza ka din kab hoga-?
uss din hoga jab unhen aag per tapaya jaye ga !
kay chakho maza apni shararat ka ! yehi hai woh cheez jiss kay baaray mein tum yeh mutalba kertay thay kay woh jaldi aajaye !
muttaqi log beyshak baaghon aur chashmon mein iss tarah rahen gay
kay unn ka perwerdigar unhen jo kuch dey ga , ussay wasool ker rahey hon gay . woh log iss say pehlay hi naik amal kernay walay thay ,
woh raat kay waqt kam sotay thay ,
aur sehri kay oqaat mein woh astaghfaar kertay thay ,
aur unn kay maal o dolat mein saeelon aur mehroom logon  ka ( ba-qaeeda ) haq hota tha .
aur unn kay liye jo yaqeen kernay walay hon , zameen mein boht si nishaniyan hain ,
aur khud tumharay apney wajood mein bhi ! kiya phir bhi tumhen dikhai nahi deta-?
aur aasman hi mein tumhara rizq bhi hai , aur woh cheez bhi jiss ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai .
lehaza aasman aur zameen kay perwerdigar ki qasam ! yeh baat yaqeenan aesi hi sachi hai jaisay yeh baat kay tum boltay ho .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya Ibrahim kay moaziz mehmano ka waqiaa tumhen phoncha hai ?
jab woh Ibrahim kay paas aaye , to unhon ney salam kaha . Ibrahim ney bhi salam kaha . ( aur dil mein socha kay ) yeh kuch anjan log hain .
phir woh chupkay say apney ghar walon kay paas gaye , aur aik mota saa bachrra ley aaye ,
aur ussay inn mehmano kay samney rakha . kehney lagay :  kiya aap log khatay nahi-?
iss say Ibrahim ney unn ki taraf say apney dil mein darr mehsoos kiya .   unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi  aur unhen aik larkay ki khushkhabri di jo bara aalim hoga .
iss per unn ki biwi zor say bolti hoi ayen , aur unhon ney apna chehra peet liya , aur kehney lagen :  ( kiya ) aik baanjh burhiya ( baccha janay gi-? )
mehmano ney kaha :  tumharay perwerdigar ney aisa hi farmaya hai . yaqeen jano wohi hai jo bari hikmat ka , baray ilm ka malik hai .
Ibrahim ney kaha :  Allah kay bhejay huye farishto ! tum kiss mohim per ho-?
unhon ney kaha :  hamen kuch mujrim logon  kay paas bheja gaya hai ,
takay hum unn per pakki mitti kay pathar barsayen
jinn per hadd say guzray huye logon  kay liye tumharay perwerdigar kay paas say khaas nishan bhi laga hoga .
phir huwa yeh kay uss basti mein jo koi momin tha , uss ko hum ney wahan say nikal liya ,
aur uss mein aik ghar kay siwa hum ney kissi aur ghar ko momin nahi paya ,
aur hum ney uss basti mein unn logon  kay liye ( ibrat ki ) aik nishani chorr di jo dardnak azab say dartay hon .
aur musa ( kay waqaey ) mein bhi ( hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unhen aik khuli hoi daleel kay sath firon kay paas bheja tha ,
to firon ney apni quooat-e-bazoo kay ball per mun morra , aur kaha kay :  yeh jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .
chunacheh hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkar ko pakra aur sabb ko samandar mein phenk diya , aur woh tha hi malamat kay laeeq !
neez qoam-e-aad mein ( bhi hum ney aesi hi nishani chorri thi ) jab hum ney unn per aik aesi aandhi bheji jo her behtari say baanjh di ,
woh jiss cheez per bhi guzarti , ussay aisa ker chorti jaisay woh gal ker choora choora hogaee ho .
aur samood mein bhi ( aesi hi nishani thi ) , jab unn say kaha gaya tha kay :  thoray waqt tak mazay urra lo .  ( phir seedhay naa huye to azab aaye ga )
iss per bhi unhon ney apney perwerdigar ka hukum manney say sarkashi ikhtiyar ki to unhen karrkay ney aa-pakra , aur woh dekhtay reh gaye .
nateeja yeh kay naa to unn mein yeh sakat rahi kay kharray hosaken , aur naa woh iss qabil thay kay apna bachao kertay .
aur iss say bhi pehlay nooh ki qoam ko bhi hum ney pakar mein liya tha .   yaqeen jano woh baray nafarman log thay .
aur aasman ko hum ney quooat say banaya hai , aur hum yaqeenan wusat peda kerney walay hain .
aur zameen ko hum ney farsh banaya hai , chunacheh hum kiya khoob bichaney walay hain !
aur her cheez kay hum ney jooray peda kiye hain ,   takay tum naseehat hasil kero .
lehaza dorro Allah ki taraf .   yaqeen jano , mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .
aur Allah kay sath koi aur mabood naa banao . yaqeen jano mein uss ki taraf say tumharay liye saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala ( ban ker aaya ) hun .
issi tarah inn say pehlay jo log thay , unn kay paas bhi koi payghumber aisa nahi aaya jiss kay baaray mein unhon ney yeh naa kaha ho kay :  jadoogar hai , ya deewana hai .
kiya yeh aik doosray ko iss baat ki wasiyyat kertay chalay aaye hain-? nahi , balkay yeh sarkash log hain .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say bey rukhi ikhtiyar kero , kiyonkay tum qabil-e-malamat nahi ho .
aur naseehat kertay raho , kiyonkay naseehat emaan laney walon ko faeeda deti hai .
aur mein ney jinnaat aur insanon ko iss kay siwa kissi aur kaam kay liye peda nahi kiya kay woh meri ibadat keren .
mein unn say kissi qisam ka rizq nahi chahta , aur naa yeh chahta hun kay woh mujhay khilayen .
Allah to khud hi razzaq hai , mustehkam quooat wala !
abb to jinn logon  ney zulm kiya hai , unn ki bhi aesi hi baari aaye gi jaisay unn kay ( pichlay ) sathiyon ki baari aai thi , iss liye woh mujh say jaldi ( azab laney ) ka mutalba naa keren .
gharz jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn ki uss din ki wajeh say bari kharabi hogi jiss ka inn say wada kiya jaraha hai .
